sources.role: Syllabus foundation for B.S. Honours in Statistics (Courses Stat H-306 Actuarial Statistics & Stat H-312 Actuarial Lab)

sources.institution: Dickson, D.C.M., Hardy, M.R., & Waters, H.R. (2020). Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks (3rd ed.)
sources.role: Premier modern textbook on survival models, life insurances, life annuities, benefit premiums, and policy reserves

sources.institution: Bowers, N.L., Gerber, H.U., Hickman, J.C., Jones, D.A., & Nesbitt, C.J. (1997). Actuarial Mathematics (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Foundational Society of Actuaries treatise on continuous life contingencies, loss distributions, and Thiele's differential equation

sources.institution: Kellison, S.G. (2008). The Theory of Interest (3rd ed.)
sources.role: Standard authoritative reference on compound interest, discount factors, annuities-certain, and amortization schedules

sources.institution: Preston, S.H., Heuveline, P., & Guillot, M. (2001). Demography: Measuring and Modeling Population Processes
sources.role: Authoritative mathematical treatment of life table construction, stable population theory, and multiple decrement models
